summary: The appellants (A-1, A-2, A-3) were acquitted by the Fast Track Court, Bijapur in 2005. The Karnataka High Court in 2009 reversed the acquittal, convicting them under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC and sentencing them to life imprisonment and fine. The present appeal challenges that reversal. The trial court had cited contradictions in eyewitness testimony, lack of incrimination of co-accused, motive of key witnesses, and improbability of agricultural activity during heavy rain. It also held the complaint to be a post-investigation document, hit by Section 162 CrPC. The Supreme Court examined the reliability of prosecution evidence, including witness credibility and procedural irregularities.
final_judgment: The Supreme Court upheld the acquittal of the appellants, finding the prosecution case unproven due to contradictions in evidence, witness hostility, and procedural defects.
